tread carefully: You should tread carefully when you talk to him about his parents' divorce, because he is still very upset.
跟他談他父母離婚的事時你應該小心行事，因為他仍然非常難過。
tread on someone's toes: I don't want to tread on someone's toes, so I will ask the team leader before I change the plan.
我不想冒犯任何人，所以在更改計畫之前我會先問組長。
tread water: Our company has been treading water for two years, with no growth in sales and no new products.
我們公司已經原地踏步兩年了，銷售沒有成長，也沒有新產品。
tread a fine line: Comedians often tread a fine line between making people laugh and hurting their feelings.
喜劇演員常常如履薄冰，遊走在逗人發笑與傷人感情之間。
tread the boards: After years of acting in movies, the famous star decided to tread the boards again in a Broadway musical.
多年演出電影之後，那位知名明星決定再次登台演出一部百老匯音樂劇。
tread a path: Instead of becoming a doctor like his parents, he chose to tread a path of his own as a musician.
他沒有像父母一樣當醫生，而是選擇走一條屬於自己的路，成為音樂家。
treasure the memory: I will always treasure the memory of our class trip to Kenting during our last summer of high school.
我會永遠珍藏高中最後一個暑假我們班去墾丁旅行的回憶。
treasure friendship: As we grow older, we learn to treasure friendship more than money or fame.
隨著年紀增長，我們學會珍惜友誼，勝過金錢或名聲。
a treasured possession: This old watch that my grandfather gave me before he died is a treasured possession that I will never sell.
這支祖父過世前送我的舊手錶是我絕不會賣掉的珍藏品。
treasure every moment: Since our grandmother is getting old, we try to treasure every moment we spend with her on weekends.
因為奶奶年紀越來越大，我們週末和她相處時都盡量珍惜每一刻。
treat someone to dinner: To thank Amy for helping me with my report, I would like to treat her to dinner at a nice restaurant.
為了感謝艾咪幫我完成報告，我想請她到一家不錯的餐廳吃晚餐。
treat a patient: The doctor needed to treat a patient with a high fever, so he left the meeting in a hurry.
醫生需要治療一位發高燒的病人，所以他匆忙離開了會議。
treat with respect: Our teacher always reminds us to treat everyone with respect, including cleaners and security guards.
老師總是提醒我們要以尊重對待每個人，包括清潔人員和警衛。
treat as a joke: Please do not treat the typhoon warning as a joke; this storm is going to be very dangerous.
請不要把颱風警報當成玩笑，這場暴風雨會非常危險。
treat lightly: Bullying at school is a serious problem that teachers and parents should never treat lightly.
校園霸凌是個嚴重的問題，老師和家長絕不應輕忽。
treat oneself: After weeks of hard work, it is fine to treat oneself to a nice meal or a movie as a reward.
經過幾週的辛苦工作，犒賞自己一頓好餐點或一場電影當作獎勵也無妨。
treat the wood: Before you paint the fence, you should treat the wood with oil to protect it from rain and insects.
在油漆圍籬之前，你應該先用油處理木材，以免受雨水和蟲害侵蝕。
tremble with fear: The little boy began to tremble with fear when the lights went out and he heard loud thunder.
燈熄了又聽到響雷時，小男孩怕得開始發抖。
tremble at the thought: Many students tremble at the thought of giving a speech in front of the whole school.
許多學生一想到要在全校面前演講就發抖。
the ground trembled: The ground trembled beneath our feet as the heavy tanks rolled slowly past us during the parade.
閱兵時沉重的坦克緩緩從我們身邊駛過，地面在我們腳下震動。
tremble with anger: When she found out that her best friend had lied to her, she began to tremble with anger.
當她發現最好的朋友騙了她時，她氣得開始發抖。
tremble for one's safety: Her parents tremble for her safety every time she goes hiking alone in the mountains.
每次她獨自去山上健行，她的父母都為她的安全擔憂。
trick someone into: Scammers often trick old people into giving away their bank passwords by pretending to be the police.
詐騙集團常常假扮警察，騙老人家說出銀行密碼。
be tricked out of money: Many old people are tricked out of money by phone scammers who pretend to be their grandchildren.
許多老人被假扮成他們孫子的電話詐騙集團騙錢。
the mind plays tricks: When you are very tired and alone in a dark house, the mind plays tricks on you and you hear strange sounds.
當你非常疲累、獨自待在漆黑的屋裡時，大腦會作怪，讓你聽到奇怪的聲音。
do the trick: If your phone stops working, simply turning it off and on again will often do the trick.
如果你的手機當機，只要關機再重新開機通常就能奏效。
trick of the trade: Adding a little salt to the coffee is a trick of the trade that many experienced baristas use.
在咖啡裡加一點鹽是許多資深咖啡師會用的行業訣竅。
up to one's tricks: The naughty boy is up to his tricks again, hiding his sister's shoes before school.
那個頑皮的男孩又在耍老把戲了，在上學前把他妹妹的鞋子藏起來。
